summary: F1: Phishing mail from edevlet-burs-basvuru.com (subject: KYK burs ödemeniz beklemede) was delivered to g.sen@aegean.edu (T1566.002). F2: The user clicked the malicious link to edevlet-burs-basvuru.com (T1204.001).

timeline.event: F1 Phishing-suspect mail delivered from edevlet-burs-basvuru.com (subject=KYK burs ödemeniz beklemede)
F2 User clicked a link to edevlet-burs-basvuru.com

findings.claim: Phishing-suspect mail delivered from edevlet-burs-basvuru.com (subject=KYK burs ödemeniz beklemede)
User clicked a link to edevlet-burs-basvuru.com

actions.action: Block edevlet-burs-basvuru.com at the email gateway and web proxy; search for and quarantine identical messages to other recipients.
Force password reset for g.sen@aegean.edu; audit mailbox rules, forwarding, and sign-in logs for post-compromise access.
If endpoint telemetry shows further activity, isolate the host and scan for credential dumping or persistence.

limitations: No confirmed malware execution or data abuse observed; compromise chain remains partial.
Escalation reason: signals of compromise without a confirmed abuse chain
not_checked: Endpoint telemetry, mailbox audit logs, and lateral movement not yet reviewed.

contrastive.explanation: Rejecting F1, F2 would leave no surviving signal and the policy would land on benign — the opposite of the human-review path we chose.

risk.rationale: F1 (CONFIRMED 0.8) confirms phishing-suspect mail delivered from edevlet-burs-basvuru.com (T1566.002) and F2 (CONFIRMED 0.7) confirms the user clicked the link (T1204.001). Together these establish exposure/initial access, but there is no confirmed credential theft or successful account takeover, so the strict contain threshold (confirmed account takeover chain) is not met. The signal is confirmed rather than weak, so monitor is too low; not explained away, so not benign. Insufficient evidence to close the chain plus possible credential exposure warrants human review.
escalate_reasons: signals of compromise without a confirmed abuse chain
